attach_oauth_to_fastapi_app: attach OAuth authentication routes and session middleware to a FastAPI application for Hugging Face login
add_oauth_routes: add OAuth login callback and logout routes to a FastAPI app using Hugging Face as the provider
generate_redirect_uri: generate an OAuth redirect URI that preserves the target URL from query parameters
redirect_to_target: redirect a FastAPI request to a target URL specified in query parameters or a default path
review_oauth_middleware: review the OAuth session middleware configuration including secret key hashing and cookie settings
